The central region is a solid black contiguous mass with irregular, mottled transition boundaries leading to the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge features a significant high-amplitude indentation near the distal tip and high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations elsewhere.
